definitions.short: Azubah , the name of two Israelitesses
definitions.full: H5806. Azubah II. עֲזוּבָה proper name, feminine 1. Αζαεβα , Αζουβα , mother of Jehoshaphat 1Kin 22:42 2Chr 20:31 . 2 ( Γ ) αζουβα , wife of Caleb 1Chr 2:18-19 ,.

occurrences.englishText: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
